EviCore's clinical guidelines (CMM-315) are used to determine medical necessity. For CPT 29806 (shoulder capsulorrhaphy), clinical review typically requires a documented history of dislocation/subluxation, 3 months of failed conservative management (including physical therapy, NSAIDs, or cortisone injections), positive physical exam signs, and supporting advanced imaging (MRI/CT).
